messages.author: 00fb4c08960da3b6
messages.subject: Plot ACF with superimposed estimate
parts:
Hi

I'm a newbie with ggplot, and I'm trying to plot a ACF-Function with
superimposed estimated values. My dataframe has in the first column
the real ACF and in the second the estimated values from my model.

With the following I can plot the real ACF but I don't now how to
insert the estimated values as a line chart.

>qplot(lag,acf_real,acf_est,data=acf,geom=c("bar"),stat="identity",position="identity")

Basically it's first column bar-chart, second column line chart in the
same Plot.

Can you help me?
Thank you very much.
Rainer

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: Plot ACF with superimposed estimate
parts:
Rainer, does something like this fit your needs?

acf <- data.frame(lag=1:5,acf_real=runif(5),acf_est=runif(5)) # dummy
data

qplot(as.factor(lag),acf_real,data=acf,geom="bar")
+geom_line(aes(x=lag,y=acf_est),color="red")

Ben
